title: Royalty OS v0.2 Trace Record Schema
description: JSON Schema module for validating trace records in Royalty OS v0.2.

trace_id.description: A stable identifier for the trace record.

origin_id.description: The origin identifier connected to this trace.

core_question.description: The central question that generated or anchors this trace.

lineage.description: Ordered conceptual lineage connected to this trace.

trace_url.description: Primary URL where this trace is published or recorded.

previous_versions.description: Previous version identifiers of this trace.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this trace record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this trace record was last updated.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the trace record.

notes.description: Additional notes about the trace record.
